Sur un marché de plus en plus concurrentiel, le Groupe Foyer reste fidèle à ses valeurs : Confiance, Excellence, Innovation, Intégrité, Indépendance. Dans le cadre du développement de ses activités, Foyer Assurances recherche pour sa Direction Opérationnelle, un(e) Gestionnaire pour son Equipe Volante.

Votre Mission
Au sein d'une équipe composée de 7 gestionnaires, vous découvrirez le monde des assurances sous ses multiples facettes via des affectations successives au sein des départements de plusieurs sociétés du Groupe : Foyer Assurances, Foyer Vie, Foyer Santé, Département Marché belge, ARAG Protection Juridique… Vous effectuerez des missions de renfort et/ou de remplacement au sein des différents services afin d'aider les équipes en place dans leur travail au quotidien et serez ainsi formé à divers métiers de l'assurance : souscripteur contrats IARD, gestionnaire Vie, gestionnaire Sinistres…

Votre Profil

Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme universitaire ou cycle court (BAC + 2/3) de préférence dans le domaine des assurances, gestion ou commerce,
Le domaine des assurances vous attire,
Vous avez un esprit d'analyse développé ainsi qu'une grande capacité d'adaptation et d'intégration,
Vous êtes flexible,
Le changement est pour vous source de motivation,
Vous êtes curieux, dynamique et sociable,
Vous maîtrisez impérativement les langues luxembourgeoise, française et allemande, la connaissance de l'anglais est un avantage.

Notre Offre
En rejoignant notre Groupe, vous bénéficierez, entre autres, des avantages suivants :

Un environnement de travail multiculturel, apprenant et innovant,
Un système d'horaire flexible,
Un restaurant d'entreprise à tarif préférentiel,
Une salle de sport avec coach,
Une conciergerie

Je rol & werkomgeving

In deze functie, word je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen en adviseren van een portefeuille van A+ klanten en begeleid je hen bij hun financiële doelen.

Je biedt jouw A+ klanten oplossingen voor het beheer van hun vermogen, de bescherming van hun gezin, de financiering van projecten en de opbouw van hun pensioen (Personal Banking Personal Approach).

Alles draait rond je commerciële ingesteldheid en proactief inspelen op de behoefte van de klant via de verschillende distributiekanalen (Mobile banking/Videobanking/face to face …).

Je werkt nauw samen met de collega's van jouw kantoor en andere productlijnen, door opportuniteiten te detecteren, en op die manier bij te dragen aan de financiële groei van jouw kantoor.

Een collega met het talent om het op te nemen en het waar te maken, die enthousiast is om anderen te helpen om succesvol te zijn en die de gave heeft om altijd een stap vooruit te zijn. Je streeft ernaar om frisse ideeën aan te brengen en uitdagingen te aanvaarden in een snel veranderende en complexe omgeving.

A Day in the Life of a Financial Expert I
As a Financial Expert, you are the first, personal, and relevant point of contact for customers in our branches.

You have knowledge of banking products in the broadest sense of the word: general banking, savings products, self-invest – easy invest, consumer lending / online mortgage intake, insurance products. Whatever the customer's question, you know how to handle it and amaze our (future) customers by translating their needs into successful sales.

Customers often choose the convenience of digital and mobile banking for their daily banking needs. However, they sometimes also need personal contact, and that's when you become the decisive factor in choosing the right product with us.

When customers visit the branch, you welcome them with open arms.

You turn this moment of contact into absolute added value for both the customer and yourself.

You present yourself as a trusted partner for the customer's financial matters and quickly identify their needs.
You use your excellent product knowledge to offer the best solution for the customer's financial question.
You consistently succeed in convincing customers to choose the fastest, simplest, and safest channel: mobile or digital banking.
You ensure that customer satisfaction (measured via CSAT/NPS) remains a top priority and always assist customers in an empathetic way.
You proactively detect commercial opportunities. You apply the 360° method and preferably convert these opportunities via digital channels.
You know exactly when a colleague from another (advice) team can better assist the customer and pass on these opportunities using the correct guidelines and tools.
You are familiar with the tools ING provides to make customer interactions efficient and digital, such as Iris, Scheduler, Salesforce, etc.
You uphold and act according to our 'Orange Behaviours.'

But above all, you don't rest on your laurels.

You are bold and enjoy proactively approaching customers. You're not afraid to spontaneously contact customers by phone to invite them for a 360° conversation.

Together with your team, you plan ahead and invite customers to events. During these events, you are the host who ensures a personal meeting. After all, you are the face of ING.

Our customers leave these interactions with a positive feeling, a product, and a wealth of knowledge. They become self-reliant and know what they can do themselves via our digital channels. You are a Digital Expert, and your enthusiasm and expertise inspire them.

The building blocks of KPIs will be the same for Financial Experts Level I and Level II: hospitality, digital coaching, expertise, and commercial skills. However, ambition levels will differ, as was previously the case between the KPIs of roles now evolving into Financial Expert.

When Are You Successful?
We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you remain curious. Keep learning. Take responsibility. In return, we will support you in growing into an even greater version of yourself.

Commercial strength: Closing a sale gives you great satisfaction. Translating customer needs into our product range is second nature to you. A commercial KPI motivates you.
Conversation partner: You are interested in the person behind the question and can add a personal touch to the interaction.
Customer focus: You can quickly analyze a customer's situation and uncover latent needs.

For every customer, you aim to deliver an outstanding experience through empathetic digital guidance and high hospitality standards.

Personal connection: You easily connect with different types of customers.
Communication: You are strong in communication and can explain complex topics clearly.
Customer coaching: You know the boundary between informing and advising and apply it correctly, including referrals.
Patience: You can maintain an overview on the work floor, even when it's busy.
Planning and organizing: You are entrepreneurial and can plan and organize high-quality events when required.

As a Financial Expert I, you get the chance to:

Grow further into Financial Expert II. In this role, you focus even more on converting needs into commercial results and turning customer contact into a Primary Mobile customer.

The Team

A branch consists of several Financial Experts, a Branch Lead, and (remote) advisory teams that provide support.
The Financial Expert is the first impression a customer has of ING. You are the face of ING.
You report to the Team Lead Financial Experts & Cashiers.

An informal, dynamic environment with innovative colleagues who support your efforts
A progressive and flexible way of working where new ideas are valued

Join our team as a Data Steward for the IT Data domain within the CIO Data Analytics Platform (CIO DAP) at Group IT/CIO Office.

What you are going to do

As a key player in ensuring data quality, integrity, and usability, you will act as the knowledge expert and liaison between data governance and business stakeholders. If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive strategic decision-making and promote a customer-centric approach, we invite you to apply and help us reach our ambitious goals.

As a Data Steward, you play a key role in ensuring robust data governance across the IT Data domain, including CIO DAP. You ensure that data and processes meet the needs of Data Users, comply with NN policies, and adhere to legal and regulatory requirements. In this role, you serve as the single point of contact for all data-related matters, supporting both internal stakeholders and external partners.

You are responsible for managing data quality by identifying, logging, reporting, and prioritizing data quality issues. You keep stakeholders informed and collaborate with Data Custodians to implement and monitor data quality controls. When risks arise, you proactively initiate preventive measures and address root causes to ensure long-term solutions.

Additionally, you manage metadata and data products using platforms such as Collibra and/or Databricks Unity Catalogue. You are responsible for developing and maintaining the Business Glossary, Data Directories, and Data Delivery Agreements, ensuring clarity and consistency in data usage across the organization.

You enable data users to work in a more data-driven way by providing access to relevant data, actionable insights, and guidance on the effective use of IT data. You also act as an ambassador for the organization's transition towards becoming a data-driven company.

What we offer you
NN invests in an inclusive, inspiring work environment and in skills and competences for the future. We match this with employee benefits that are in line with what is needed today and in the future. This way, we offer our employees the opportunity to get the best out of themselves. We offer you:

Salary between €5,363 and €7,661 depending on your knowledge and experience (40 hours per week)

13th month and holiday allowance are paid with your monthly salary

27 vacation days for a 5-day working week and one Diversity Day

A modern pension administered by BeFrank

Plenty of training and learning opportunities

NS Business Card 2nd class, which gives you unlimited travel, also privately. Do you prefer to travel with your own transport? Then you can declare the kilometers travelled

Allowances for setting up your home office and for internet use

Who you are

You have a thorough understanding of IT as a business to be able to align with the many stakeholders and their respective interest in data about our IT landscape and its usage.

You are a data enthusiast, who is passionate about data usage and data quality. You have a strong analytical mind, and you can translate data issues into clear and actionable solutions or actions.

You are a proactive and collaborative team player, who can communicate effectively with various stakeholders and influence them positively. You are organized and like working with various stakeholders.

Furthermore, you have:

A relevant academic degree, with a focus on Data Science, Data Management, Business Analytics, or a related field

Preferably experience in data governance, data quality and data management

Knowledge of data governance frameworks, methodologies and best practices, such as DAMA-DMBOK

Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, knowledge of Dutch

Knowledge of the IT4IT Reference Architecture of The Open Group

Knowledge of Collibra and PowerBI

Who you will work with

As a Data Steward within the CIO Office, you will collaborate extensively with a wide range of stakeholders both within and outside of Group IT. NN fosters a values-based culture that emphasizes bringing out the best in individuals. Operating in a diverse, open, and inspiring environment, we strive to sustainably grow our business while playing an active role in society.

In this role, you will report directly to the Manager IT Generic Support Services.

Job Description Summary

The Programme Lead will be responsible for driving the Treasury Transformation Programme through its preparation phase in 2026 and ensuring the plan is execution ready for 2027 onwards.

This role requires strategic leadership, strong governance, and the ability to deliver a multi-year transformation that integrates treasury data and systems into a single cash flow engine.

In addition, the successful candidate will lead Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book (IRRBB) improvement projects during 2026, focusing on enhancing interest rate risk reporting and management ahead of the strategic Treasury Transformation Programme in 2027.

About This Opportunity

This is a unique chance to lead the Treasury Transformation Programme at Lloyds Banking Group, driving strategic change and innovation in treasury operations.

As Programme Lead, you'll be responsible for preparing the organisation for a transformation to revolutionise Treasury technology and processes.
Why Lloyds Banking Group
If you think all banks are the same, you'd be wrong. We're an innovative, fast-changing business that's shaping finance as a force for good. A bank that's empowering its people to innovate, explore possibilities and grow with purpose.

Lead the end-to-end Treasury Transformation Programme in 2026, ensuring delivery of objectives and landmarks.
Create and sustain the programme roadmap, governance framework, and reporting structures.
Engage and influence senior colleagues across Treasury, Finance, Technology, and Risk.
Oversee design related governance.
Ensure alignment with regulatory requirements and internal risk frameworks.
Manage programme resources, and financial controls.
Drive cultural and operational change to embed new processes and systems.

Lead Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book (IRRBB) improvement projects in 2026 to strengthen interest rate risk reporting and management.

What You'll Need
Proven track record of leading large-scale transformation programmes in financial services.
Strong knowledge of treasury operations, liquidity management, and risk frameworks.
Experience in interest rate risk management and regulatory reporting frameworks.
Experience in data and technology integration projects.
Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills.
Ability to manage complex governance and regulatory requirements.
Strong financial awareness and budget management experience.

At Ayvens, progress starts with you.
Our ambitions to shape the future of sustainable mobility are powered by our talent. Join us, and get better with every move.
Make your move
De mobiliteit in Nederland is vastgelopen. Het wordt drukker en drukker op de weg, en we staan steeds vaker vast in het verkeer. Dat vraagt om een radicaal nieuwe aanpak. Daarom hebben ALD Automotive en LeasePlan hun krachten gebundeld om samen nog sneller en nog verder te komen. Wij zijn Ayvens. Jouw partner in mobiliteit
Ayvens is de wereldwijde speler in mobiliteit. Wij herdefiniëren de mobiliteit van morgen met oplossingen waar vandaag om vraagt. Wij zijn er voor iedere leaser, zakelijk of privé, met voertuigen die variëren van (elektrische) auto tot e-bike. Zo maken we mobiliteit duurzamer, makkelijker en beter met elke kilometer.
Dat kunnen we niet alleen. Daarom zijn we op zoek naar collega's met dezelfde ambitie en energie. Mensen die verandering niet uit de weg gaan, maar er vol in meegaan.
Bij Ayvens steken we energie in alles. Ook in jouw groei.
Ben jij op zoek naar een carrière waarin je kunt doorgroeien en positieve impact kunt maken. In ons Commercial Talent Program is een plek voor je vrij.
Commercial Talent Program
Bij Ayvens in Nederland werken ruim 1000 collega's met veel passie en plezier. Ook bij binnen het Commercial Talent Program, dat 8 weken duurt. Dit talentenprogramma staat in het teken van onboarding van nieuwe medewerkers van Ayvens. Deze commerciële talenten beginnen hun loopbaan bij de grootste leasemaatschappij ter wereld.
Na jouw eerste introductiemaand maak je verder kennis met verschillende commerciële teams. Als je het talentenprogramma met succes hebt afgerond, zoeken wij samen met jou een fijne plek in een Sales team dat bij jou past.
Wat ga je doen?
Als deelnemer aan het Commercial Talent Program ga je aan de slag bij een van onze Sales teams. Je belt online-aanvragen na en leert ons werkproces tot aan de bestelling van een auto of bedrijfswagen. Daarnaast benader je zelf potentiële klanten, werk je offertes uit en verzorg je de follow up. Zo doe je ervaring op in het acquireren en beheren van MKB tot grote corporate klanten.
Ook maak je kennis met verschillende onderdelen en werkgebieden van het vak. Bijvoorbeeld door de branchetraining VNA-Leasing, interne (verkoop)trainingen en door mee te werken op de afdelingen binnen Ayvens.
Wat breng je mee?
HBO opleiding, het liefst in de commerciële richting;
Stage- of werkervaring in een commerciële rol is een pré;
Teamspirit;
Ambitie en drive om je verder te ontwikkelen;
Open blik om werkwijzen en processen te verbeteren en te veranderen;
Zelfstandigheid en probleemoplossend vermogen;
Affiniteit met auto's en/of bedrijfswagens;
Resultaatgerichtheid, ondernemerschap en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel.
Wat bieden wij jou?
Werken bij werkgever met een grote ambitie op schone, veilige en slimme mobiliteit;
Doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen Ayvens in Nederland of Internationaal;
Ambitieuze organisatie met uitdagende doelen waar we hard werken. We maken ook tijd voor plezier en vieren graag onze successen
Hybride werken;
Werken bij Top Employer of the year;
Lidmaatschap van Young Ayvens (organiseert lezingen, workshops, cursussen, sportieve evenementen en netwerkborrels).
Momenteel zijn we gevestigd in Almere/Hoofddorp, maar medio februari 2026 verhuizen wij naar ons splinternieuwe kantoor The Joan in Amsterdam. Een modern, inspirerende plek die perfect past bij ons ambities.
Better with every move

By leveraging our unique position to lead the way to net zero and further shape the digital transformation of the industry, we are well-positioned to meet the evolving mobility needs of our clients and provide them with the solutions they need to thrive.
At Ayvens, we believe that our success is driven by our commitment to customer satisfaction. Our team is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions and technology-enabled services that help our customers focus on their everyday business. Job Description

The Risk Services Quality Assurance team is a centralised team responsible for QA activities across the bank, including both Commercial and Retail franchises' pre and post-sales activities.

The Quality Assurance Analyst will ensure that the bank's products, services, and operations meet the relevant standards of quality and compliance by conducting effective Quality Assurance testing and analysis, specifically for Collections & Recoveries.

Our testing approach is data-driven, utilising systematisation and AI integration. The Quality Assurance Analyst will have an open and inquisitive mindset to challenge conventional QA practices by leveraging AI and analysing data to evaluate customer outcomes.

The Quality Assurance Analyst will be responsible for ensuring that findings, financial remediation, and account rectification identified through testing are communicated to stakeholders and addressed correctly within the instructed timescales. They will be confident in engaging in challenging discussions with stakeholders about findings, whilst adopting a pragmatic approach to reaching agreements.

Responsibilities specific to the role include but are not limited to:

QA Testing: Apply a holistic and independent perspective to assess customer outcomes and staff adherence to the bank's policies and processes, in line with the QA Framework.
Data and AI: Leverage AI tools and data analysis to evaluate customer outcomes by identifying patterns, anomalies, and potential risks across large datasets. Use sentiment and trend analysis to inform continuous improvement efforts.
Outputs: Identify and instruct financial remediation and account rectification, ensuring actions are completed as directed. Maintain a log of poor customer outcomes, including details of financial remediation and account rectification where applicable.
Analysis: Review and analyse QA testing outputs to identify common trends and themes, and assess whether findings indicate systemic issues. Recommend enhancements to processes, procedures, systems, and controls.
Engagement: Collaborate with colleagues across the business to share findings, identify root causes, and agree on corrective actions.
Thematic Reviews: Conduct deep-dive or enhanced QA testing in line with the QA plan or on an ad-hoc basis as required.
Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the development and refinement of the QA framework, tools, and reporting mechanisms to ensure alignment with regulatory expectations and evolving business needs.

Qualifications

Minimum 2 years Quality Assurance/Customer Outcome experience.
Minimum 2 years Collections & Recoveries experience.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Experience/knowledge of TCF, CCA, MCOB, & CONC.
A good understanding of Residential and BTL Mortgages, Unsecured Loans and/or Motor Finance.
Familiarity of AI technologies, data tools, and their functionalities.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Excellent planning and organisational skills.
Able to work under pressure and to tight deadlines.
Accuracy & Attention to detail.
Confident testing multiple product types.
